Strapping pin: GPIO 0 must be HIGH during boot (pulled up by default). If driven LOW externally, the chip enters bootloader mode.

format_code:
chip esp32

hardware {
    pin led: Output = 2
    pin btn: PullUpInput = 0
    bus i2c0: I2C(sda: 21, scl: 22)
    device bme: BME280 on i2c0 at 0x76
}
